description: Replication Data for Geospatial Assessment of Flood Vulnerability and Its Impact on Food Security in Downstream Communities of Shiroro and Zungeru Dams, Niger State, Nigeria is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Harvard Dataverse. Replication Data Description This replication dataset supports the study Geospatial Assessment of Flood Vulnerability and Its Impact on Food Security in Downstream Communities of Shiroro and Zungeru Dams, Niger State, Nigeria. It contains all spatial and non-spatial data required to reproduce the flood vulnerability modeling, exposure analysis, and food security assessment presented in the study. Coverage: Niger, Nigeria. The portal files it under the publisher Harvard Dataverse. Its tags are Earth and Environmental Sciences, Flood vulnerability. The repository dates the deposit 2026; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
